scenes.hook: H T M L Forms Introduction. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: A form groups controls that collect information from a user. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Give controls labels so people can understand what to enter. Read the example from top to bottom.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw. Small changes in code can change the output.
scenes.tip: The name attribute identifies a field when form data is submitted. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: A form alone does not save data; it needs a submission handler. Understanding this helps you avoid a common beginner mistake.
scenes.try: Create a labeled email field and a submit button. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
